episodeTitle.en: “Dumbest idea I’ve heard” to $100M ARR: Inside the rise of Gamma | Grant Lee (co-founder)
episodeTitle.zh: “我听过最愚蠢的主意”到1亿美元年营收：Gamma崛起记 | 格兰特·李（联合创始人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Grant Lee is the co-founder of Gamma, the AI-powered presentation tool that’s one of the hottest and most interesting AI startups in the world right now. They’re valued at over $2 billion, and they hit $100 million ARR in just over two years, with a lean team of just around 30 people. Unlike many fast-growing AI startups, Gamma has been profitable for most of its history, has not raised significant funding, and they built a massive business in a category most investors dismissed. In fact, one investor told Grant his idea was “the dumbest idea he had ever heard.” *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 格兰特·李是AI驱动演示工具Gamma的联合创始人，该公司目前是全球最热门、最具创新性的AI初创企业之一。他们估值超过20亿美元，仅用两年多时间就达成1亿美元年营收目标，团队仅有约30人。与许多快速发展的AI初创公司不同，Gamma在大部分发展历程中都是盈利的，没有筹集大量资金，却在大多数投资者视为冷门的领域建立了庞大业务。事实上，一位投资者曾告诉格兰特，他的想法是“他听过最愚蠢的主意”。*我们探讨了：*

title.en: “Dumbest idea I’ve heard” to $100M ARR: Inside the rise of Gamma | Grant Lee (co-founder)
title.zh: “我听过最愚蠢的主意”到1亿美元年营收：Gamma崛起记 | 格兰特·李（联合创始人）

summary.en: Grant tells the story of building Gamma as a small, profitable team serving 50M+ users—despite one investor calling it the 'worst idea' he'd ever heard—and how they grew through hands-on influencer marketing, onboarding micro-influencers manually rather than paying for big creators to read scripts. He shares a relentlessly experimental cadence (idea in the morning, live experiment by afternoon, iterate by evening) and why most people wrongly dismiss the presentation category as a real business. The episode is a tactical masterclass in profitable, sustainable AI-startup growth.
summary.zh: Grant 讲述了用一支精干、盈利的团队服务 5000 万以上用户、打造 Gamma 的故事——尽管有投资人说这是他听过“最烂的点子”，以及他们如何通过亲力亲为的影响者营销实现增长：手动 onboard 微影响者，而非花钱让大网红念脚本。他分享了毫不松懈的实验节奏（早上出点子、下午跑实验、晚上迭代），以及为何大多数人都错误地低估了“演示”这个品类能做成大生意。这期节目是关于盈利、可持续的 AI 创业公司增长的战术公开课。
